items.title: Godot XR Community Game Jam VI
items.en_title: Godot XR Community Game Jam VI
items.en_oneliner: The sixth Godot XR community game jam received 28 entries on the theme Adrift, with the article counting down the top five, worth referencing for XR developers.

items.title: Skydance Has Everything It Needs Except Focus
items.en_title: Skydance Has Everything It Needs Except Focus
items.en_oneliner: Warner Bros.' gaming boss admitted the company grew distracted chasing too many IPs, and after a run of expensive failures, this piece examines why Skydance has everything it needs except focus.
